comparison.objective: Chop a row of basil leaves using a two-handled mezzaluna, then return the tool.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual grasping and repeated rocking of a curved cutting blade.
comparison.success_condition: Every leaf chopped, mezzaluna returned to its rest, and arms returned; no numeric chop-size or damage thresholds stated.
comparison.reason: Repeated rocking blade cuts deformable leaves; it does not test recessed coaxial alignment, discrete impact control, insert retention, or metal-fragment containment.
